content.value_statement: End-to-end tests often become slow, flaky, and hard to maintain. This skill provides practical Playwright and Cypress patterns for stable workflows, CI execution, and focused coverage.
actual_capabilities: Helps identify critical user journeys suitable for end-to-end coverage.
Provides Playwright configuration patterns for retries, tracing, screenshots, and browser projects.
Provides Cypress patterns for custom commands, selectors, requests, and intercepts.
Explains test data fixtures, cleanup, and safe account usage.
Guides CI parallelization, sharding, reporting, and artifact capture.
Covers accessibility and visual regression testing patterns.
limitations: It does not run tests or verify an application environment by itself.
Examples must be adapted to each project, framework, and authentication model.
It is not a substitute for production safety review or secure test data handling.
It focuses on E2E testing and does not replace unit or integration test design.

use_cases.title: Plan Critical Workflow Coverage
use_cases.description: Define the smallest useful E2E suite for login, signup, checkout, or other high-value journeys.

use_cases.title: Stabilize Flaky Browser Tests
use_cases.description: Replace brittle selectors and fixed waits with robust locators, assertions, fixtures, and cleanup steps.

use_cases.title: Prepare CI Test Execution
use_cases.description: Configure retries, browser projects, sharding, reports, traces, screenshots, and failure artifacts for pipelines.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Starter E2E Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a new test suite.
prompt_templates.prompt: Identify the critical E2E journeys for this application and propose a small first test suite with success criteria and safe test data needs.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Existing Test Stability
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these E2E test descriptions and suggest stronger selectors, wait strategies, fixture setup, and cleanup steps to reduce flakiness.

prompt_templates.title: Design Playwright or Cypress Patterns
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced implementation guidance for a chosen framework.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an E2E implementation plan for this workflow using Playwright or Cypress, including page objects, custom commands, network mocking, and artifact capture.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize CI Browser Coverage
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a CI strategy for this E2E suite with browser coverage, retries, sharding, reports, trace retention, and rules for blocking releases.

output_examples.input: Plan E2E coverage for signup, login, and profile editing.
output: Prioritized journeys: successful signup, failed login, successful login, and profile update.
Recommended data strategy: create isolated test users and remove them after each run.
Key assertions: visible confirmation messages, correct redirects, and persisted profile changes.

output_examples.input: My checkout test fails randomly in CI.
output: Likely causes: fixed waits, shared data, slow network responses, or selectors tied to layout.
Recommended fixes: wait for user-visible state, mock unstable services, capture traces, and isolate cart data.
CI action: retry once with trace and screenshot retention for failed runs.

output_examples.input: Prepare a browser test suite for release gates.
output: Use a focused smoke suite for pull requests and a fuller suite before release.
Run Chromium for fast feedback and schedule Firefox, WebKit, and mobile coverage where risk is higher.
Store reports, videos, screenshots, and traces as pipeline artifacts.

best_practices: Test user-visible behavior and critical paths before adding broad edge-case coverage.
Use stable accessibility locators or data attributes instead of layout-dependent selectors.
Run tests against safe environments with isolated accounts, deterministic data, and cleanup.
anti_patterns: Do not use fixed waits when the test can wait for a visible state, URL, response, or assertion.
Do not run destructive or state-changing tests against production systems.
Do not put every validation into E2E tests when unit or integration tests give faster feedback.

faq.question: Does this skill generate tests for Playwright and Cypress?
faq.answer: It provides patterns and planning guidance for both tools. Generated tests still need project-specific adaptation.

faq.question: Can it fix flaky tests automatically?
faq.answer: No. It helps identify common causes and suggests safer selectors, waits, fixtures, and CI diagnostics.

faq.question: Should E2E tests cover every feature?
faq.answer: No. Use E2E tests for critical user journeys and rely on lower-level tests for detailed edge cases.

faq.question: Does it require real production accounts?
faq.answer: No. It recommends dedicated test accounts, test data, and safe non-production environments.

faq.question: Can it help with accessibility testing?
faq.answer: Yes. The playbook includes accessibility testing patterns using automated checks as part of E2E workflows.

faq.question: Can Codex or Claude Code use this skill in a repository?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code for test planning and implementation guidance.
